response.text: {"name":"Rob stekla","idea":"The page is built like a stack of cut glass sheets: every section is a pane bounded by the thin green edge that only glass shows when you look at it side on, and the glazier's promise of a same or next day repair stands on the first pane in letters as big as a shop window.","palette":[{"role":"background","hex":"#eef4f3"},{"role":"surface","hex":"#ffffff"},{"role":"text","hex":"#14202a"},{"role":"muted","hex":"#4a5c62"},{"role":"primary","hex":"#0f6b5c"},{"role":"onPrimary","hex":"#e6f4ef"},{"role":"accent","hex":"#9ee3cf"},{"role":"border","hex":"#c5d6d2"},{"role":"band","hex":"#0e1f24"},{"role":"onBand","hex":"#dfe9e8"}],"pairing":"archivo-public-sans","typeCharacter":"Archivo is a plain workshop sans with a hard edge, like letters cut with a straightedge; Archivo Bold at about 8vw for the one h1, sentence case, tight leading and slightly negative tracking, Archivo Semibold 40 to 48px for section headings, Public Sans Regular 18 to 20px for running text, Public Sans Medium 15px for list labels, the phone number in Archivo Bold at about 5vw.","composition":"Section 1, hero, ground #eef4f3, 4 rows: a 6px rule in #0f6b5c runs the full width along the very top of the section, the glass edge. Columns 1 to 8, rows 1 to 2: the h1 left aligned at about 8vw. Columns 1 to 5, row 3: the lead at 20px in #14202a. Columns 9 to 12, rows 1 to 4: a tall vertical field in #0f6b5c bled to the right page edge and to the bottom of the section; inside it, top aligned, the line 'Nujno? Pokličite' in Public Sans 15px #e6f4ef and under it the phone as a large numeral at about 5vw in #e6f4ef; at the bottom of the field the address in 15px. Columns 1 to 7, row 4: the layout system's line drawing in #14202a, 1px: a rectangle in landscape with one straight diagonal score line from the top left corner area to the bottom right and a tiny circle where the score begins, nothing else. No button in the hero, the phone numeral is the one action. Section 2, ground #ffffff, 1 row: a full width ribbon of short words separated by a 1px #0f6b5c vertical rule: Okna, Vrata, Tuš kabine, Ogledala, Kuhinje, Ograje, Izložbe, Okvirji; Public Sans Medium 15px, sentence case, closed above and below by 6px rules in #0f6b5c. Section 3, services, ground #eef4f3, 8 rows: heading 'Kaj naredimo iz stekla' columns 1 to 6 row 1, the services lead columns 1 to 5 row 2 in 18px #4a5c62; rows 3 to 8 a list where each offering is one full width row from column 1 to 10 divided by a 1px #c5d6d2 rule, the name in Archivo Semibold 28px columns 1 to 5 and the given description in Public Sans 17px columns 6 to 10; offerings with no description leave columns 6 to 10 empty, the rule still runs. Section 4, story, band #0e1f24, 3 rows, top edge again a 6px rule in #9ee3cf: heading 'Steklarstvo v Vipavski dolini od leta 1988' columns 1 to 9 in #dfe9e8 at 48px, the story text columns 1 to 6 in #dfe9e8 18px; columns 8 to 12 row 2 to 3 the four highlights as a compact list with 1px #9ee3cf rules between them, 16px #dfe9e8. Section 5, hours and place, ground #ffffff, 3 rows: heading 'Delavnica je odprta med tednom' columns 1 to 6 row 1; opening hours as a table columns 1 to 4 rows 2 to 3 with 1px #c5d6d2 rules; columns 7 to 12 rows 1 to 3 the schematic map in #14202a lines on #eef4f3 with the point Goriška cesta 30 marked by a #0f6b5c square, address and email beneath it in 15px. Section 6, area, ground #eef4f3, 2 rows: heading 'Kje delamo' columns 1 to 4, the area text columns 5 to 10 at 20px. Section 7, call, full width field in #0f6b5c, 3 rows, top edge a 6px rule in #9ee3cf: heading 'Imate razbito steklo ali potrebujete mero?' columns 1 to 8 at 48px in #e6f4ef, the call text columns 1 to 6 in 18px #e6f4ef, the phone as a large numeral columns 1 to 7 row 3 at about 5vw in #e6f4ef, and the one rectangular button 'Pokličite' in #0e1f24 with #dfe9e8 label at columns 9 to 11 row 3; footer below in #0e1f24 with address, email and hours in one line.","imagery":"No photographs anywhere. The only picture is the layout system's line drawing in the hero: a 1px ink rectangle with one diagonal score line and a small circle at the start of the cut, sitting on the pale ground under the lead. Everything else is colour and rule: the 6px glass edge rule in #0f6b5c or #9ee3cf at the top of every section, the tall green field at the right of the hero, the dark story band, the services list ruled like a cutting list, and the schematic map in ink lines.
